name: Dozy Lamp
summary: A sleepy desk lamp with a rope pull cord that wakes up and lights the room when you tug it
about: A mint desk lamp snoozes in a dark room, blowing a snore bubble while little z's float up. Tug its swinging rope cord: the bulb flickers on, the lamp stretches awake and watches your pointer, light sparks burst out and dust and a moth dance in the warm beam while the whole page brightens. Good for a playful hero, a light and dark switch or a cosy landing page.
how: Grab the bead at the end of the cord and drag it down (or swing it about), then let go.
Pull far enough and the bulb flickers on: the room lights up and the lamp wakes with a stretch.
The rope reels back in and swings with real physics; pull again to send the lamp back to sleep.
A tap, or Enter and Space on the focused cord, plays a full pull for you.
With reduced motion the cord hangs straight, nothing flickers and the dust and moth stay still.
